verdict.rationale: The www.sos.ca.gov guidance pages appear reachable by a keyless agent: content was extracted from bizfile, forms, information-requests and service-options pages, and probes on that host returned ordinary 404s rather than a bot wall. However, the bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov portal, which hosts the public business search and record images the guidance points to, serves an Incapsula bot-management SPA shell even for robots.txt, so part of the public reading surface is walled. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 on guidance pages with an identified UA, and an unwalled bizfileonline search/records surface.
